Well Teddy was the man or at least he thought he was. Quickly running to the door kind of jump barking at you till he was picked up. Then quiet till he was put down again. Such a fiesty little guy.I remember Seth telling me whenever he got into bed Teddy would try to intimidate him out of it. Kayla was his how dare he. But as time went on they came to an understanding that Kayla was both of theirs. So they became family and added to it because they had love to share. And there lies the thing that will be missed and we grieve. It is the space that love occupied that is vacant now. The physical expression of it anyways. But Teddy is with you as he is with me in writing this. I also will miss the little guy. But I think the memory that is clearest to me. And kind of sums things up was during covid. You guys would come over with the dogs abit. It was a chilly evening. Teddy wanted to get next to Kayla who had a blanket. He was just sitting there patiently waiting for her to get things adjusted and just right for him. When all was done he snuggled contentedly. Kayla looked up and laughed saying 'I know he is spoiled. But he's my little man'. Thats what loving does to us and we are bette for it.
